content: अरूप {%a.%} .²1 Formless, shapeless. .²2 Ugly, deformed. .²3 Dissimilar, unlike. .{@-पम्@} .²1 A bad or ugly figure. तामरूपामसतीं भक्षयिष्यामि मानुषीम् <ls>Rām.</ls> .²2 The Pradhāna of the Sāṅkhyas and Brahman of the Vedāntins. .²4 Not possessed of द्रव्य and देवता; अरूपः शब्दः श्रूयमाणः <ab>&c.</ab> <ls>ŚB. on MS. 4. 4. 1</ls>. (It may be observed that द्रव्य and देवता form the रूप or form of a sacrifice).
